verdict.rationale: A direct probe found an OpenAPI document served at docs.caveman.so/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing the "openapi" key), so a machine-readable API spec can be downloaded. The evidence confirms only that the file exists and is valid OpenAPI; nothing describes its contents or how it is maintained. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and what it covers, evidence of the spec's completeness or currency, independent corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
